payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how the proposed training framework mitigates bias patterns in natural language inference datasets.

claims.text: The proposed training framework effectively mitigates the bias pattern by reducing the misleading effects of annotation artifacts and improving models' semantic learning ability.
The framework allows for artifact-balanced learning by assigning specific weights to samples, which helps balance the distribution of artifacts across different classes.
Experimental results demonstrate that the framework improves the generalization ability of models in cross-dataset testing.
